dataset.name: UVG 4K test sequences
dataset.license: CC BY-NC; non-commercial use only; cite Mercat et al., ACM MMSys 2020
dataset.citation: A. Mercat, M. Viitanen, J. Vanne, UVG dataset: 50/120fps 4K sequences for video codec analysis and development, ACM MMSys, 2020.

source.license: CC BY-NC; non-commercial use only; cite Mercat et al., ACM MMSys 2020

model.name: FSRCNNSubpixel-d16-s8-m1-c16-x2
model.quantization: per-output-channel symmetric INT8 weights; symmetric per-layer INT16 activations; INT32 bias/accumulator; Q1.15 PReLU

color_path.y: frozen R0 INT8/INT16/INT32 FSRCNN x2 followed by frozen Q14 Keys bicubic x2; per-frame hashes equal the prior 4K quality evaluation
color_path.cbcr: source 4K 4:2:0 Cb/Cr downsampled to 480x270 with Pillow BICUBIC and enlarged to the 4K 4:2:0 chroma grid 1920x1080 with Pillow BICUBIC; same chroma path for baseline and R0
color_path.display_conversion: full-range YCbCr to RGB using fixed-point BT.709 coefficients; panels resized to 640x360
color_path.baseline: direct Pillow BICUBIC x4 for Y and the same interpolated Cb/Cr path
color_path.reference_panel: decoded 4K Y with decoded 4K Cb/Cr for visual context; not a quality score

video.codec: H.264, yuv420p, BT.709 tags, no audio

limitations: The side-by-side video is a software preview, not a full-resolution color-quality measurement.
The current FPGA model enhances Y only; Cb/Cr interpolation is a software placeholder and is not verified on board.
UVG source is CC BY-NC and may only be used non-commercially; the raw source is not included in this repository.
